source_message.text:
Mara,

The points you proposed work for us, and we’re happy to incorporate that wording into the contract. You’ll receive the contract for review on Friday.

While that is being prepared, the Author Guidelines document is attached for you to review here: <https://docs.google.example/document/d/career-conversation-outline-042/edit?usp=sharing>

If anything raises a question, please let me know.
